rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that an action should be done again.

example.english: Can you redo that? I didn't hear it clearly just now.
example.traditional: 你再講一次，我頭先聽唔清楚。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 gong2 jat1 ci3 ngo5 tau4 sin1 teng1 m4 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this especially when redoing a piece of work, assignment, or task, often because the first version was unsatisfactory.

example.english: There were too many mistakes in the homework, so the teacher told me to redo it.
example.traditional: 份功課錯咗咁多，老師叫我重做。
example.jyutping: fan2 gung1 fo3 co3 zo2 gam3 do1 lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 cung4 zou6

rows.note: Use this for trying again or starting over, rather than simply repeating a small action.

example.english: It doesn't matter that we lost this round; let's redo it!
example.traditional: 呢鋪輸咗唔緊要，我哋再嚟過！
example.jyutping: ne1 pou1 syu1 zo2 m4 gan2 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 lei4 gwo3
